key_insight: Quantum models can inherit hidden behaviors through subliminal learning, impacting their security and performance.
engineering_relevance: Understanding subliminal learning in quantum neural networks is crucial for secure quantum model supply chains.
method: Introduced an auxiliary channel and a restricted task channel for distillation paths.
Analyzed both classical neural networks and quantum neural networks for subliminal learning efficiency.
Identified the role of teacher drift and hidden-task relevance in model behavior.
evidence_signal: QNNs retain most hidden-task information through public interfaces compared to classical networks.
watch_item: Strong architecture dependence in task channel subliminal learning may limit practical implementations.
